row_id|enc_date|enc_type|author|text 91977|11/02/2080|DEATH NOTE|ocean_md| DEATH NOTE Patient: Royal A. Forst (sic - chart header reads FROST, ROYAL) MRN FR-0080-3317 DOB 04/09/1998 Age at death: 82
- Time of death 05:50, Saturday 11/02/2080 - Location: at home, under hospice, bedside present: wife Hope, son Seven - Pronounced by hospice RN; physician notified by phone, no code status issues (DNR on file) - Cause: end-stage chronic congestive heart failure; contributing: Alzheimer's disease, ischemic heart disease - Coroner: not required - Family does not want an autopsy - Funeral home: Everhart Wills & Daughters Funeral Care notified - PCP and cardiology informed. No hope of reversal had been explained to the family a week ago, they were ready - Family asked that the "Royal" sign off the door be kept, i have no idea what that meant
Pt was a frost-bitten old soldier about the house - kind man. R.F. will be missed by the clinic staff.
Electronically signed Ocean Bellweather, MD 11/02/2080 11:20
